title: Review of lab 1's active-droplets/ad9-ledger (IB): first labkit packs of this world, fresh seeds 3 and 4: 12 discrete droplets with an amphiphile shell (psi rim/core 4.82 and 4.56, membrane-like in 61/62 and 57/59 droplets); 6 persistent splits each, generation 1 and 3
summary: Labkit packs of threads/active-droplets/worlds/ad9-ledger/world.py, unchanged, 128^2, t=0-20000. 12 droplets at the end on both seeds; splits 6 and 8, 6 persistent each, max generation 1 and 3, merges 0 and 1. Only psi is membrane-like: rim/core 4.82 and 4.56, rim/out 14.5 and 14.0, 61/62 and 57/59 droplets individually; droplet material, catalyst and the kp-rung channel are not (rim/core 0.88-0.99).

verdicts.limitation: The shell is a quasi-equilibrium coating of a droplet-made amphiphile, as in ad3/ad4; no source ablation run. The ledger and heredity parts (L7) were not examined.
